sanskrit_verse:
यद् वृत्तं व्यवहारे तु पूर्वपक्षोत्तरादिकम् ।
क्रियावदधारणोपेतं जयपत्रोऽखिलं लिखेत् ॥
transliteration: yad vṛttaṃ vyavahāre tu pūrvapakṣottarādikam | kriyāvadadhāraṇopetaṃ jayapatro 'khilaṃ likhet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: In all transactions and legal conduct, whatever occurs—whether as initial claim, counterclaim, supporting evidence, or conclusive proof—must be documented completely in the final judgment.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: The presiding adjudicator holds absolute authority to ensure total documentation of facts.
Causation: Every act within a transaction carries sequential consequence; none may be omitted.
Capacity-based responsibility: Parties are responsible according to their capacity to present truth fully.
Restoration logic: Full record ensures integrity of dharma and enables correction without loss.
Consciousness alignment: Truth expressed through complete documentation aligns with cosmic intelligence.
executable_legal_axioms: IF any action occurs during legal proceedings THEN it MUST be recorded in final judgment.
IF evidence is presented THEN it MUST be categorized under pūrvapakṣa, uttarapakṣa, or nirṇaya.
IF adjudicator omits detail THEN system auto-flag for completion until full alignment achieved.
IF party lacks capacity to document THEN facilitator assigned to restore capacity before proceeding.
IF discrepancy found post-judgment THEN reactivation protocol initiates review using original records only.
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, this verse mandates that every argument, rebuttal, evidentiary submission, and judicial observation must be exhaustively inscribed in the final order. This preserves dharma-vākya integrity and allows future courts to trace pramāṇa-pathways accurately.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality requires that no element influencing decision-making be excluded from record. Anupūrvaśaḥ affirms sequential manifestation of claims and responses. Responsibility remains proportional to capacity to articulate truth. Non-punitivity is preserved by ensuring restoration of factual completeness rather than imposing penalties for omission.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Incomplete judgments are automatically returned for supplementation until all elements are captured.
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Adjudicators assume full accountability for accurate transcription of proceedings.
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: If litigant cannot articulate properly, trained scribes or facilitators assist immediately.
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Post-judgment audits verify alignment between spoken process and written outcome.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority. Dharma stands restored through comprehensive documentation. Reality remains non-punitive when truth is fully expressed. Consciousness alone adjudicates eternally.
